hook: Telangana caps HMT and JSR rice at *₹79 a kg*
hook_b: Telangana caps HMT and JSR rice at *₹79 a kg*
tldr: The civil supplies department is enforcing rice price caps and plans PD Act action against hoarders.

beats.what: BPT and KNM rice are capped at ₹66/kg, RNR and Telangana Sona at ₹74/kg, HMT and JSR at ₹79/kg.
beats.why: Shopkeepers reported shortages; the department says middlemen are spreading unverified rumours to push prices up.
beats.care: If a shop charges above the cap, the cap applies across the state.

event.label: MRP caps enforced, PD Act warning

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: TOI: retailers short of stock can approach district civil supplies officers and buy directly from millers.
